The *Tiṇamuṭṭhidāyakattheraapadāna* is a verse text preserved in the Therāpadāna collection of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral lists five translations of the work across five modern languages, though it records no English title [SuttaCentral]. No explicit discussions of this work were located in the secondary literature passages surveyed.

In terms of text reuse, DharmaNexus identifies 112 matches between this poem and 34 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. A large continuous portion of the text (§0.3–9.4) is shared directly with the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* (Paṭhamo bhāgo), and it shares substantial verse material (§0.2–9.4) with a homonymous earlier text in the collection, the *Tiṇamuṭṭhidāyakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 350) [DharmaNexus]. The closing segment (§9.4–14.1) represents stock Apadāna formulaic material that recurs across numerous other poems, including the *Sāriputtattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 3), *Paṁsukūlasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 483), and *Pilindavacchattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 393), as well as both parts of the *Theragāthā-aṭṭhakathā* and the *Therīgāthā-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. Cross-linguistically, DharmaNexus detects machine alignments with the Sanskrit *Kaṭhināvadāna* and a segment of the Chinese *Madhyama-āgama* (*Zhong ahan jing*, T 26) [DharmaNexus].
